verdict.rationale: Docs and a real runtime probe confirm skills are installed as ordinary, editable plain files (SKILL.md) that can be fully read after installation, and the source SKILL.md files are publicly viewable on GitHub/raw URLs before installing, satisfying 'read every file afterward' and implicit pre-install inspection via the public repo. However, there's no explicit dedicated CLI command (e.g. a 'list' or dry-run preview) shown that enumerates exactly what a skill will add before install — missing for 10: a documented pre-install listing/preview command, and independent confirmation that all (not just one sampled) skill files are equally transparent.
